pages.title: By a Pick
pages.text: The Anvil supports equipment maintenance after difficult descents.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use a pickaxe against a nearby wall while falling. Hard walls hold; softer surfaces slow the slide. Double crouch releases. Pickaxe tier and Grip/Momentum change behavior.
